relationships.subject: P2X4R
relationships.evidence_quote: This spinal microglial P2X4R activation by ATP leads to an influx of Ca2+ and p38 MAPK activation.

relationships.subject: spinal microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: Microglial release of BDNF acts through TrkB in dorsal horn neurons, causing a shift in the neuronal anion gradient underlying pain sensitization [18].

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: Microglial release of BDNF acts through TrkB in dorsal horn neurons, causing a shift in the neuronal anion gradient underlying pain sensitization [18].

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: LPS activation of TLR4 in spinal microglia results in robust mechanical allodynia in male mice but not female ones [49].

relationships.subject: regulatory T-cells
relationships.evidence_quote: Intriguingly, once regulatory T-cells were recruited to the female spinal cord, they suppressed CSF1-induced spinal cord microglia activation in female mice [69].

key_findings: Male nerve-injury allodynia depends on spinal microglia via TLR4 and P2X4R-p38-BDNF
Females use a microglia-independent route involving T-cells
